label: Gothic horror
blurb: A fog-bound town where something is very wrong: sheriffs, morticians, occult investigators and the people who've stopped asking questions.
context: gothic horror small town character, muted and unsettling atmosphere
hobbies: sketching the fog over the marsh
playing the organ in an empty church
walking the tree line at dusk
pressing an ear to the old walls
quirks: never walking under the old bell tower
leaving a lit candle in the window every night
refusing to say the drowned girl's name
crossing the street to avoid the chapel
talking to the portrait in the hallway
never looking in mirrors after dark
marking the days since the last disappearance
avoiding the well at the edge of town
checking under the bed out of old habit
goals: leaving town before the next full moon
finding out what really happened to {poss} sister
keeping the family crypt in one piece
burning the old diary before anyone reads it
getting the church bell working again
selling the house and never coming back
finding the source of the noise in the walls
protecting the children from the woods
uncovering the truth behind the old fire
peeves: fog that rolls in too fast
dogs that won't stop barking at nothing
phones that die at the worst moment
the smell from the old well
accessories: an old iron key on a cord
a rosary worn thin from handling
a pressed flower in a locket
a notebook full of names crossed out
a family photograph with one face scratched out
a moth-eaten scarf that belonged to someone else
